I'm Olorato Motlhabane, founder of Rato Studio, where we offer more than just a place on the internet — we build custom digital platforms tailored to scale your business. We fuse bold, responsive layout engineering with thoughtful strategy to establish a bulletproof presence for your brand. Every platform Rato Studio creates is driven by performance, clarity, and lasting business growth.
I craft modern, custom digital platforms that leave a lasting impression and establish a bulletproof online presence for your business.

From deep-dive briefings to final quality assurance, I prioritize clear communication, transparent pricing, and tailoring every step to meet your unique goals.

What exactly does the development fee cover vs. the monthly fee?

The R1,000 or R1,500 setup fee covers the complete design, engineering, and launching of your website. The monthly fee (R400 – R600) covers premium cloud hosting, security certificates, platform licenses, and ongoing maintenance so your site stays live and lightning-fast.
